notes: P64acd861b2 G4: 'its activated abilities can't be activated unless they're mana abilities.' Fetters (the opponent's) on Animal Sanctuary: the {2},{T} counter ability is refused (no counter, the {C}{C} stays). Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The {T}: Add {C} mana ability still works: with the pool's {C}{C} it pays Palladium Myr's {3}, and the Sanctuary taps.
